subject.title: feat(cli): `skills uninstall` design proposal + prior art reconciliation

question: Should OpenClaw add `openclaw skills uninstall <slug>` now, and should it delete only ClawHub-provenanced skills or also handle manually managed skill directories?
rationale: The missing command is source-supported, but it is a destructive workspace-state operation and the issue explicitly leaves manual-skill, global/agent targeting, and Gateway alignment semantics for maintainer choice.

options.title: Approve narrow ClawHub-provenanced CLI
options.body: Land a focused command that removes only path-contained ClawHub-tracked/provenanced skill state plus the lockfile entry, with manual skills refused or warned.

options.title: Defer to Gateway-first design
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers define a shared Gateway lifecycle API that the CLI can call or mirror.

options.title: Reject core uninstall for now
options.body: Document manual cleanup and lockfile repair instead of adding a destructive CLI surface.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow ClawHub-provenanced CLI
recommendation.body: Land a focused command that removes only path-contained ClawHub-tracked/provenanced skill state plus the lockfile entry, with manual skills refused or warned.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ClawHub update-policy and current-line history make this the best available owner for the lifecycle semantics choice.
